- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#3 ("Figure widths, type sizes, table conventions of the chosen venue") by `venue-repo`  > On fonts: the template asks for only embedded Type-1 fonts and names Type 3 as the thing to avoid; it does not say whether embedded TrueType in an included figure is rejected, and I could not establish that. Lowest-risk route if TeX is usable in your sandbox: `text.usetex=True` with a Times preamble (mathptmx/times), which makes matplotlib's PDF backend embed Type 1; check each file with `pdffonts`. If that is not practical, keep `pdf.fonttype=42` (never Type 3) and record it in the caption notes. Not blocking. For information: I built paper-repo's dev skeleton (ca150dd): style file identical to the kit, all fonts Type 1, so the figures are the only place a non-Type-1 font could enter.
